title: Reconstitute every UNRDF workspace package from admitted authority

subject.scope: Every package returned by pnpm recursive workspace discovery, including package examples that are declared workspaces

problem: UNRDF contains a large package graph whose implementation, package metadata, imports, lint, build, tests, integration boundaries, generated surfaces, and receipts are not collectively proven. Every package is UNKNOWN until independently executed and admitted.
outcome: A dependency-closed, deterministic ggen manufacture graph generates or repairs package authority, manifests, source, tests, documentation, and verifier bindings; exact-head execution produces package receipts; an independent aggregate verifier computes bounded standing without self-certification.

calculus.generation_law: Generated artifacts are projections. Repair ontology, manifest, template, projector, or admitted inputs; never hand-edit generated output.
calculus.actuation_law: Zero unreceipted actuation. Publication occurs only after exact-head receipts and replay evidence exist.

inputs: existing generated artifacts and provenance markers
package-matrix receipt from the exact candidate head
outputs: generated or repaired package implementation surfaces

required: declared public exports resolve after build
lint and type boundaries execute when declared
positive and negative tests execute when declared
cross-package dependencies resolve against the same workspace head
generated surfaces have authority and drift verification
failures are typed and never masked
receipt binds source, authority, toolchain, commands, outputs, and result

standing.PARTIAL_ALIVE: bounded package checkpoints pass but integration or replay remains open
standing.ALIVE: all declared package checkpoints, imports, integration witnesses, receipt validation, and replay pass
standing.BLOCKED: required authority, toolchain, permission, or dependency is unavailable
standing.BUILD_BROKEN: declared manufacture or verification command executes and fails
standing.UNSUPPORTED: surface is outside the admitted package contract

positive_witnesses: ggen render from admitted package authority produces deterministic outputs
every non-private package root export imports successfully
clean-room replay reports NO_SEMANTIC_CHANGE, NO_GENERATED_DRIFT, and REPLAY_MATCH
negative_falsifiers: declared export path does not exist
test, lint, or build command masks failure
generated output changes without authority change
replay differs from the first manufactured tree
a package is promoted to ALIVE without exact-head execution
aggregate verifier accepts UNKNOWN package standing
exclusions: claiming repository crown from package-local tests
